ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (black/dark grey) base pixels occupy approximately 85-90% of the visible surface; high-intensity (white) pixels are sparse, occupying 10-15% primarily at the distal margins and median notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity (white) clusters at the left distal tip [x:110-170, y:240-360] and right distal tip [x:840-900, y:340-440]. Focal white linear mottling concentrated around the median notch [x:440-520, y:380-480].

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 82 degrees; vertical depth from lobe peak to notch vertex is approximately 65 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge; pixel amplitude of valleys ranges from 3 to 12 pixels relative to adjacent peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a moderately concave trajectory from the median notch toward the distal tips, characteristic of a standard hyperbolic curve fit.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct high-contrast white circular/semi-circular clusters located at the extreme distal edges of both lobes, typical of barnacle colonization scars.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent vertical high-intensity linear streak at [x:468, y:400-475] and several lower-intensity diagonal parallel streaks on the right lobe [x:650-750, y:490-590].

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable vertical white scar proximal to the median notch; significant jagged irregular nicks and material loss along the trailing edge boundary; dark circular spot/indentation at [x:488, y:585].
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, well-defined circular dark pixel cluster (potential puncture mark or deep focal lesion) located approximately 100 pixels inferior to the median notch vertex.
